presentation.summary: Match manga and add rich metadata, covers, contributors, and publication details.
presentation.description_markdown: Uses MangaBaka as the primary source, with MangaDex as a deep fallback and optional AniList banner artwork. It can also keep a local MangaBaka database for fast, rate-limit-free matching on large libraries.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin and add **Manga Metadata** to a manga library's provider chain. The defaults use live sources. For large libraries, enable the local MangaBaka dump and ensure the configured storage path has about 1.5 GB available; the initial download is roughly 335 MB.

capabilities.description: Rich manga metadata from MangaBaka — covers, synopsis, authors, genres, publication status, publisher, and cross-provider IDs — aggregating AniList, MyAnimeList, MangaUpdates, Kitsu, Anime-Planet, and Shikimori, with a MangaDex deep fallback and AniList banner backdrops. Optional offline mode downloads MangaBaka's database for fast, rate-limit-free matching on large libraries.

global_config_schema.title: Enabled sources
global_config_schema.description: Comma-separated source IDs to search (mangabaka, mangadex). Empty uses the default set.

global_config_schema.title: Use local MangaBaka dump
global_config_schema.description: Download MangaBaka's database (~335MB, ~1.5GB on disk) for offline, rate-limit-free matching. Recommended for large libraries. Default off.

global_config_schema.title: Dump storage path
global_config_schema.description: Override where the dump is stored. Default: OS cache dir. Point at a roomy volume if needed.

global_config_schema.title: Dump refresh interval (hours)
global_config_schema.description: How often to re-download the dump. Default 168 (weekly).

global_config_schema.title: AniList banner backdrops
global_config_schema.description: MangaBaka has no banner art. When on, fetch a hero backdrop from AniList by id for matched series. Default on.
